assessments.classification: Fresh bounded 95e source nonfinding, not a SATS decoder witness or new issue count
assessments.evidence: The selected strategic encounter helper sums burden/capacity and calls encumbrance_remaining_multiplier, then clamps the returned f32 and passes it to UnitBasisPoints::from_unit_f32 before expect. The inspected multiplier first applies finite_nonnegative: NaN or nonpositive maps to zero, positive infinity maps to f32::MAX, otherwise retains the finite value. It returns zero for zero capacity, and clamps 1 minus a nonnegative ratio to [0,1].
assessments.reasoning: For the visible f32 branches, the sanitized positive capacity and finite nonnegative burden make the ratio nonnegative or positive infinity; the clamped result is finite within [0,1]. UnitBasisPoints::from_unit_f32 checks finite and this interval before bounded construction. This is source-level reasoning, not an executed fixture, proof of all earlier data quality or policy approval of sanitization.
assessments.relation: This direct float-to-owner construction is distinct from feature-gated SATS deserialization of a UnitBasisPoints value. It is additional 95e caller context to q131 and does not close the wire-admission question. Any data-quality or burden-policy issue requires separately identified owner, assumptions and ledger reconciliation.
